name: NGC 1756 (Hubble)
blurb: NGC 1756, a star cluster in the Large Magellanic Cloud, seen by Hubble.
label: ngc1756-hubble
story: NGC 1756 is a compact cluster of stars in the Large Magellanic Cloud, first recorded by John Herschel in 1836. Its stars are thought to be about 200 million years old.
